exposure: Adherence to surgical antibiotic prophylaxis (SAP) guidelines (antibiotic prescribed, timing of administration, duration of use)
outcome: Rates of adherence to surgical antibiotic prophylaxis (SAP) guidelines (appropriate antibiotic prescription, timely administration, recommended duration)
cohort: Two hundred and eighty surgical procedures, including cesarean sections, performed at Ain Shams University Hospital of Obstetrics and Gynecology.
finding: The study found high rates of non-adherence to surgical antibiotic prophylaxis guidelines, especially concerning the timing of administration and duration of use, with no cases showing full adherence, and identified key barriers such as knowledge gaps and workflow inefficiencies.
